create_sgd_experiment: create an Experiment instance with an ENN, loss function, optax optimizer, and dataset iterator
train_experiment_batches: train the Experiment for a specified number of SGD batches with periodic logging
predict_with_experiment: run a forward pass through the trained Experiment model on input arrays using a PRNG key
evaluate_loss_on_batch: evaluate the loss of the trained Experiment on a single batch of data
review_training_state: review the TrainingState NamedTuple structure holding params, network state, and optimizer state
